paragraphs: The Lockheed Martin Corporation is an American defense and aerospace manufacturer. It is headquartered in North Bethesda, Maryland, United States. The company was formed by the merger of the Lockheed Corporation with Martin Marietta on March 15, 1995.

Lockheed Martin operates 4 divisions: Lockheed Martin Aeronautics (39% of 2024 revenues); Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control (18% of 2024 revenues); Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (24% of 2024 revenues); and Lockheed Martin Space (18% of 2024 revenues).

As of 2023, it is the top contractor of the United States federal government, and has been since at least 2008. As of 2024, 73% of the company's revenue came from the federal government, including 65% from the United States Department of Defense. In 2024, 26% of revenue was from sales of the F-35 fighter.

Lockheed Martin is also a contractor for the U.S. Department of Energy and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). It also provides products and services to the Department of Defense and the Department of Energy to the Department of Agriculture and the Environmental Protection Agency. It is involved in surveillance and information processing for the CIA, the FBI, the Internal Revenue Service (IRS), the National Security Agency (NSA), the Pentagon, the Census Bureau, and the Postal Service.

The company has received the Collier Trophy six times, including in 2001 for being part of developing the X-35/F-35B LiftFan Propulsion System and in 2018 for the Automatic Ground Collision Avoidance System (Auto-GCAS). Lockheed Martin currently produces the F-35 and leads the international supply chain, leads the team for the development and implementation of technology solutions for the new USAF Space Fence (AFSSS replacement), and is the primary contractor for the development of the Orion command module. The company also invests in healthcare systems, renewable energy systems, intelligent energy distribution, and compact nuclear fusion.

The company also manufactures the MIM-104 Patriot air-defense system and its PAC-3 MSE interceptor. In 2026, Lockheed Martin announced plans to increase PAC-3 MSE production to 2,000 interceptors annually by the end of the decade, expanding production capacity in response to increased demand and the need to replenish U.S. and allied inventories.

people.name: Timothy S. Cahill
people.title: President - Missiles and Fire Control
people.bio: Mr. Cahill has served as President of Missiles and Fire Control since November 2022. He previously served as Senior Vice President Global Business Development & Strategy and Senior Vice President Lockheed Martin International.
people.quote: Timothy S. Cahill (age 60), President - Missiles and Fire Control

people.name: Stephanie C. Hill
people.title: President - Rotary and Mission Systems
people.bio: Ms. Hill has served as President of Rotary and Mission Systems since June 2020. She previously served as Senior Vice President, Enterprise Business Transformation from June 2019 to June 2020.
people.quote: Stephanie C. Hill (age 61), President - Rotary and Mission Systems

people.name: Robert M. Lightfoot, Jr.
people.title: President - Space
people.bio: Mr. Lightfoot has served as President of Space since January 2022. He previously served as Vice President, Operations and Vice President, Strategy and Business Development for Space.
people.quote: Robert M. Lightfoot, Jr. (age 62), President - Space

people.name: Kevin J. O'Connor
people.title: Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Mr. O'Connor has served as Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary since January 2025. Before joining Lockheed Martin, he served as Senior Vice President and Chief Legal Officer of Carrier Corporation from January 2020 until January 2025.
people.quote: Kevin J. O'Connor (age 58), Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary

people.name: H. Edward Paul, III
people.title: Vice President and Controller
people.bio: Mr. Paul has served as Vice President and Controller since June 2022. He previously served as Vice President, Accounting from March 2015 to June 2022.
people.quote: H. Edward Paul, III (age 50), Vice President and Controller

people.name: Maria A. Ricciardone
people.title: Vice President, Treasurer and Investor Relations
people.bio: Ms. Ricciardone has served as Vice President, Treasurer and Investor Relations since January 2024, after serving as Vice President, Investor Relations beginning in October 2022. Before joining Lockheed Martin in October 2022, she held finance leadership roles at Arrow Electronics and Hubbell Incorporated.
people.quote: Maria A. Ricciardone (age 50), Vice President, Treasurer and Investor Relations

people.name: Evan T. Scott
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Mr. Scott has served as Chief Financial Officer since April 2025. He previously served as Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Missiles and Fire Control and as Vice President and Treasurer.
people.quote: Evan T. Scott (age 48), Chief Financial Officer

people.name: Frank A. St. John
people.title: Chief Operating Officer
people.bio: Mr. St. John has served as Chief Operating Officer since June 2020. He previously served as Executive Vice President for Rotary and Mission Systems from August 2019 to June 2020.
people.quote: Frank A. St. John (age 59), Chief Operating Officer

people.name: James D. Taiclet
people.title: Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Mr. Taiclet has served as President and Chief Executive Officer since June 2020 and Chairman since March 2021. He has served on Lockheed Martin's Board of Directors since January 2018.
people.quote: James D. Taiclet (age 65), Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer

people.name: Gregory M. Ulmer
people.title: President - Aeronautics
people.bio: Mr. Ulmer has served as President of Aeronautics since February 2021. He previously served as Vice President and General Manager, F-35 Lightning II Program from March 2018 to January 2021.
people.quote: Gregory M. Ulmer (age 61), President - Aeronautics
